_comment: The finish gate (docs/CONTRACTS.md section 33): opt-in harness control at the end of a
turn, declared as `[verify] finish_gate = "v2"` in policy.toml. Recorded as
`counters.finish_gate` on the turn record and TaskRecord, and as one `finish_gate` audit
record per end of a turn the gate judged. A readout parses these without reading the code,
so renaming a key, a mode, an action, an outcome, a caveat id or an evidence id is a
contract change. packages/gnomon-core/src/finish_gate.test.ts asserts the module against
this file and that CONTRACTS.md names the section, the kind and every value below.
finish_gate_loop.test.ts holds the off-by-default claim: with no gate declared, or
finish_gate = "off", a scripted turn sends request bodies whose sha256 matches master's.
